_readme: Example profile. Invented, not a real person. Shows how the template works for a design search; copy it and replace every field with your own.
name: Your Name
headline: Senior and lead product design roles
resume_summary: Senior Product Designer with 8 years on complex web applications. Owns end-to-end design for a core product area: discovery research, interaction design, prototyping, and design QA through ship. Maintains a shared component library with front-end engineering and runs the critique process for a team of four designers. Prior work spans healthcare software and consumer mobile. BFA in Graphic Design. Tools: Figma, FigJam, Maze, Dovetail, Storybook, basic HTML and CSS.
fit_signals: Owns a product area end to end, from research through shipped interface
Design has real influence, not a service desk taking tickets from product
Design systems, accessibility, or research depth is treated as core work
Senior, lead, or staff level with mentorship or craft leadership
anti_signals: Marketing, brand, or graphic production work dressed up as product design
Junior or associate level individual contributor
Agencies doing pure execution with no ownership
Unpaid spec work or take-homes framed as the interview
